subtitle: Engineer and Sustainable Society

keywords: Market, Customer 2.Company, Engineer 3.Quality, Cost, Delivery, Safety 4.Innovation 5.Career design
educationalGoal: Students are interested in social trends and learn to understand market trends and customer needs. Students then understand the activities of companies in society and the role of engineers in preparing for their success as engineers. Students will also learn about the social expectations and quality, cost, delivery and safety that engineers need. Students can understand that innovation is important for the realization of a sustainable society and connect it with their career design.
advice: The students considered the future career direction in the "Basic Style for Study" in the first year. Based on this, in this course students will learn the following items needed to do a good job at the company. (1) Understand the trends of sustainable society such as SDGs, the role of companies, and the responsibilities and rewards of engineers working there. (2) Learn basic management knowledge and matters related to the work of engineers, such as R & D and production processes. (3) Understand that there are a wide variety of industries in society, and engineers are active in various occupations in a wide range of fields. (4) Deepen understanding of the work of engineers by exchanging opinions on items investigated by themselves through group discussions and presentations. (5) Learn examples of innovation in order to play an active role in a developing society.

activityGoals.body: Being interested in sustainable society, market and customer trends, and being able to report.
Understand the roles of companies and engineers that contribute to society.
Understand Quality, Cost, Delivery, and Safety, and be able to investigate and analyze the company.
Be able to understand your life plan and be able to present your own opinions at group discussions.
Be able to understand how to become an engineer who contributes to society.
